text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to onboard astera-2.3b-compact into the model-catalog tomorrow 2026-03-19 10:30 PT. Goal: publish as astera/compact:2.3 and keep a soft alias for backward compatibility. Need smoke lead + rollback lead. Expected warmup ~2-3m per instance.

cheng: I can own quant/profile. Planning q4_s8 with dynamic-kv fallback. Will run perf + quality sweep tonight and post numbers by 05:30 PT.

oliver: I can take smoke. Do we want a canary (traffic split) or just catalog pin + staged rollout? Leaning to a small canary (10%) to catch infra regressions.

tara: I can be rollback lead. Please ensure runbook steps in the PR: how to flip alias and how to hard-rollback the catalog entry. Also confirm shard count and expected memory.

maria: Thanks. Handing off checklist we should have in the PR: 
- model metadata (id, shards, quant profile)
- perf + eval summary + small prompt set
- infra tags (kernel hints)
- canary routing plan + weight table
- smoke script path and expected exit criteria
- rollback steps + owner tags

Quick copyable checklist block:```
- PR: models/astera/2.3 metadata + evals
- infra: tag "compact-kernel"
- canary: us-west2 host tier 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m
- smoke: ./devops/smoke_astera.sh (expect 200 && streaming)
- rollback: model-catalog rollback v2.3 (owner: tara)```

cheng: config snippet I'm testing: 
```yaml
model:
  id: astera-2.3b-compact
  quant: q4_s8
  alias: astera/compact:2.3
  shards: 1
  note: dynamic-kv enabled
```
Perf quicknote: p50 ~14ms/token on g5x2 (with warmup). Will post full table.

oliver: smoke script (very small):
```bash
# devops/smoke_astera.sh
set -e
resp=$(curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"astera/compact:2.3","prompt":"hello"}')
# expect 200 + streaming markers
echo "$resp" | grep -q '"choices"' || exit 1
```
I'll run this in staging then run it against the canary after merge.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: model-catalog PR #5123 will merge at 1737658000 (2026-03-19 10:30 PT). Canary ramp plan: 10% -> 25% (15m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (1h) if no alerts.

jess: FYI API teams — if you rely on alias "astera/compact:latest" we will add a 24h redirection window and notify you before cutover. @product please ack if this impacts client SDKs.

sre: Please confirm resource request in PR. Add alert thresholds: latency p95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% during canary. We'll create a temporary dashboard.

maria: Owners assigned: smoke -> oliver, rollback -> tara, quant/profile -> cheng. I'll open the PR now and tag you all. If anyone hits a blocker post here or DM. :rocket:
